title: Emergent Non-Markovian Nonlinear Qubit From Collective Spin Interactions
summary: Open-system descriptions are typically introduced by coupling a quantum system to an external environment. Here we show that a closed interacting many-body system can itself generate a controlled non-Markovian quantum channel acting on a reduced nonlinear qubit through finite-size corrections to a nonlinear mean-field limit. We demonstrate this using the Kitagawa-Ueda one-axis twisting model, $H=χJ_z^2$, a paradigmatic model of collective spin dynamics, spin squeezing, and two-component Bose-Einstein condensates.
